panelUpdate.heading: Panel updates
panelUpdate.subtitle: The version this panel runs and the release available for it.
panelUpdate.upToDate: None, the panel is up to date
panelUpdate.inProgress: An update is queued or running.
panelUpdate.hint: The update installs the signed release the last check found. Progress and the result, including an automatic rollback, appear in the task list.
panelUpdate.confirmQuestion: The panel installs the available release and restarts. If the health check fails, it returns to the previous version by itself.
panelUpdate.started: The update was requested. Follow it in the task list.
